title: [Pre-Phase 1] Scaffold solution structure (Api, Web, Core, Data, Mobile)
body:
## Goal
Scaffold the target solution layout from `docs/architecture-design.md` §1 so the redesign has a stable project boundary.

## Scope
- Add projects under `src/`:
  - `ReMind.Api` (ASP.NET Core Web API)
  - `ReMind.Web` (React SPA shell)
  - `ReMind.Mobile` (React Native placeholder)
  - `ReMind.Core` (domain models, DTOs, shared contracts)
  - `ReMind.Data` (EF Core DbContext, configurations, migrations host)
- Update `ReMind.sln` to include the new projects
- Keep existing `ReMind.Frontend` / `ReMind.Functions` HTTP surface only until cutover (do not delete yet)
- Decide and document package references needed for Phase 1 (JWT, EF Core, NetTopologySuite placeholders OK)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Solution builds with new empty/stub projects
- [ ] Layout matches §1 tree
- [ ] No behavior change to current deployed Razor/Functions save path yet
- [ ] README notes the target structure and retirement plan

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §1, §13 Pre-Phase 1

title: [Pre-Phase 1] Retire ReMind.Database as schema source of truth
body:
## Goal
Make EF Core migrations in `ReMind.Data` the schema source of truth before the first redesign DB deployment.

## Scope
- Remove `ReMind.Database` / `azure/sql-action` create-if-missing path from deploy and CI **before** first EF-backed deployment
- Inventory shared/dev/prod environments for existing `dbo.DataPoints` rows (mandatory §3 check)
- If live rows exist, stop and produce a dedicated data-disposition/migration plan; do not assume greenfield
- Keep SQL project files only if explicitly retained as reference; they must not deploy

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Deploy/CI no longer applies schema via `ReMind.Database`
- [ ] Environment inventory result documented in the PR/issue notes
- [ ] Initial EF migration path is the only remaining schema apply mechanism (even if migration content lands in Phase 1)

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §1 decisions, §3 Migration Strategy, §11 CI/CD, §13 Pre-Phase 1

title: [Pre-Phase 1] Wire early CI for .NET + Node (Web/Mobile stubs)
body:
## Goal
Extend CI so the redesigned solution structure is validated early (dotnet + Node) without waiting for full feature work.

## Scope
- Update/add workflows to restore/build/test .NET solution including new projects
- Add Node steps for `ReMind.Web`: `npm ci`, `npm run build`, `npm test` (stub OK)
- Add React Native validation stubs for `ReMind.Mobile` (TypeScript check / Jest placeholder)
- Fail CI on format/lint/type errors for touched stacks when tooling is present
- Keep existing Playwright harness green against current stack until SPA cutover

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] PR CI builds new projects
- [ ] Node web pipeline runs on path changes under `src/ReMind.Web`
- [ ] Mobile TS/Jest stub job exists (can be continue-on-error only if explicitly temporary and tracked)

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §11, §13 Pre-Phase 1

title: [Phase 1] Entra External ID tenant + app registrations (API, SPA, Mobile, Admin role)
body:
## Goal
Stand up Microsoft Entra External ID as the identity provider for ReMind clients and API.

## Scope (mostly manual/external — document as runbook)
- Create Entra External ID tenant (separate from SQL server Entra)
- Register applications:
  - API: expose scopes/audience for `ReMind.Api`
  - React SPA: MSAL.js Authorization Code + PKCE
  - React Native: MSAL or Expo AuthSession + PKCE
- Configure social IdPs: Google, Apple, Facebook
- Define Admin app role/group claim (`roles` contains `Admin`) — no self-service assignment
- Store non-secret configuration (tenant, client IDs, scopes) for Terraform/appsettings; secrets only in Key Vault where required

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Runbook documents tenant + three app registrations + Admin role
- [ ] SPA and mobile can obtain tokens against the API audience in a non-prod tenant
- [ ] Admin role claim format matches §8 default

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §4, §8 Admin role claim, §10 Manual/External Resources, §13 Phase 1

title: [Phase 1] EF Core model + initial transactional migration for full §2 schema
body:
## Goal
Materialize **all** of §2 (core + supporting tables) in `ReMind.Data` via EF Core, with a safe migration strategy.

## Scope
- Entities/configurations for: Users, AvatarUploads, DataPointChains, DataPoints, Tags, DataPointTags, UserConsents, GpsFixes, ErasedSubjectHashes, UserErasureRequests, UserExportRequests, Media, OutboxMessages, Follows, Comments, Reactions, Reports
- Constraints, filtered unique indexes, soft-delete query filters on DataPoints/Comments
- **Initial migration is transactional only** (tables, constraints, non-spatial indexes) — no `CREATE SPATIAL INDEX` here
- Seed system tags + deploy-time system tombstone user as required by erasure design
- Geography columns via NetTopologySuite; SRID 4326 checks

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Full §2 column contracts present in model
- [ ] Initial migration applies cleanly on empty DB and is retry-safe
- [ ] Soft-delete filters default-on
- [ ] Unit/integration tests cover model constraints where practical

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §2, §3, §13 Phase 1

title: [Phase 1] Dedicated spatial-index migration (nontransactional, retry-safe)
body:
## Goal
Add `IX_DataPoints_Location` (and any other spatial indexes) in a **subsequent** migration that SQL Server will accept.

## Scope
- Separate migration whose sole nontransactional command is spatial index DDL via `migrationBuilder.Sql(..., suppressTransaction: true)`
- Existence guard so replay is safe (`IX_DataPoints_Location` absent check or equivalent)
- Do not mix unguarded table creates into this migration

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Spatial index exists after migrate
- [ ] Re-running migration is a no-op / safe
- [ ] Documented in migration notes why it is split from initial schema

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §2 spatial index, §3 Migration Strategy, §12 SQL notes

title: [Phase 1] ReMind.Api foundation: JWT auth, fallback policy, Problem Details, EF+NTS
body:
## Goal
Stand up `ReMind.Api` as the public HTTP API host with secure defaults from §3–§5.

## Scope
- ASP.NET Core Web API project on the solution
- JWT bearer via Microsoft Identity Web (`AzureAd` config) against Entra External ID
- `FallbackPolicy = RequireAuthenticatedUser`
- `UseAuthentication` + `UseAuthorization` before endpoint mapping
- Explicit `AllowAnonymous` only for: `GET /healthz/live`, `GET /api/erasure-requests/{id}` (+ legacy alias)
- RFC 7807 Problem Details helper with stable `type`/`code` values
- EF Core + `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer.NetTopologySuite` DI
- OpenAPI/Swagger enabled
- CORS allow-list of known SPA origins (no `*`)
- Rate limiting foundation (package or gateway hooks) for later endpoint quotas

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Unauthenticated calls to protected routes return 401
- [ ] `/healthz/live` is anonymous and does not JIT users
- [ ] Problem Details content-type on sample 400/401/403/404
- [ ] DbContext resolves with NTS geography mapping

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §3–§5, §8, §11–§12, §13 Phase 1

title: [Phase 1] Caller identity directory + JIT user provisioning with erasure blocklist
body:
## Goal
Resolve internal `Users.UserId` only from validated JWT (`iss` + `oid`/linked subject). Never trust client-supplied user ids.

## Scope
- User directory service mapping token → `Users` row
- JIT create on first authenticated request unless blocked
- Load `SubjectPseudonymKey` versions from Key Vault: current + every version still referenced by `ErasedSubjectHashes`
- Compute versioned `HMAC-SHA-256` subject hashes; if any match, return 403 `account-closed` and do not provision
- Do not use plain SHA-256 of subject

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] First login creates Users row
- [ ] Erased subject cannot reprovision (integration test with seeded hash)
- [ ] No API accepts caller userId from body/query for authZ

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §2 ErasedSubjectHashes, §3 Caller Identity, §12 erasure

title: [Phase 1] Opaque cursor infrastructure (Data Protection, caller-bound, TTL)
body:
## Goal
Provide shared opaque pagination cursor protect/unprotect used by all visibility-dependent list endpoints.

## Scope
- ASP.NET Data Protection (`IDataProtector`) or equivalent authenticated handles
- Payload includes `callerUserId`, route, seek keys, bound query inputs
- Default TTL 10 minutes (§8)
- Redeem rejects tampered/expired cursors and `callerUserId` mismatches without leaking which field failed
- Typed helpers for nearby, chain-candidates, timeline, feed, comments, follow-requests, in-bounds modes

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Unit tests for expire, tamper, caller mismatch, route mismatch
- [ ] Shared API used by later endpoint issues

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §3 cursors, §5 Design Notes, §8 cursor TTL

title: [Phase 1] Scaffold ReMind.Web map shell (auth + Leaflet/Mapbox)

title: [Phase 1/10] Terraform foundation: App Service P1v3 API host, SQL SKU, identities
body:
## Goal
Update IaC toward the target API host and identity baseline (can land incrementally with later infra issues).

## Scope
- Service plan upgrade path to **P1v3** for `ReMind.Api`
- Linux Web App repurposed for API; document/separate static host for SPA
- SQL database SKU S0+ for spatial performance
- Managed identities for API (and workers later); Key Vault access scaffolding
- App settings via Key Vault references; no plaintext SQL connection strings when AAD auth is available
- Anonymous `/healthz/live` ready for Front Door probes (wiring in later FD issue)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Plan shows intended host/SKU/identity resources without destroying unrelated state unexpectedly

title: [Phase 2] Operational defaults configuration module (§8 bounds)
body:
## Goal
Centralize §8 numeric bounds/TTLs so API validation, clients, quotas, and janitors agree.

## Scope
- Strongly typed options for radii, page sizes, media limits, SAS/pending TTLs, cursor TTL, receipt entropy, retention windows, etc.
- Environment overrides via configuration
- Shared validators for lat/lng/radius/pageSize

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Defaults match §8 table exactly
- [ ] Invalid bounds rejected with stable Problem Details codes in shared helpers

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §8

title: [Phase 2] Profiles API + avatar upload pipeline (AvatarUploads)
body:
## Goal
Implement user profile read/update and caller-scoped avatar init/complete with quota-safe reservations.

## Scope
- `GET /api/users/{id}` — avatar as short-lived signed read URL only
- `PUT /api/users/me` — display name/bio only; reject client blob paths
- `POST /api/users/me/avatar` + `/complete` per §5/§6
- `AvatarUploads` one-live-reservation invariant, `ClientRequestId` idempotency, `PendingReservedBytes` conditional debit
- Prefer size-enforcing proxy for avatars (10 MB max)
- Malware/signature gates; set `Users.AvatarBlobPath` server-side only after clean path

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Concurrent avatar replace cannot double-charge two live reservations
- [ ] Idempotent init returns same UploadId/SAS without second debit
- [ ] Client cannot set AvatarBlobPath directly

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §2 AvatarUploads, §5 user endpoints, §6, §8 avatar max

title: [Phase 2] Consents + GPS fix mint/redeem APIs
body:
## Goal
Gate GPS-assisted flows with stored consent and short-lived server `gpsFixId` handles.

## Scope
- `POST/GET /api/users/me/consents` upsert single current row per (UserId, Purpose, PolicyVersion)
- `POST /api/users/me/gps-fixes` mints fix only with non-revoked LocationGps consent
- Every redeem re-checks consent still granted
- TTL 5 minutes; janitor cadence 1 minute (worker can be separate issue but hooks required)
- Map-pin flows do not require GPS consent but coordinates remain personal data

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Revoked consent blocks mint and redeem
- [ ] Expired fixes are not redeemable
- [ ] No client-declared location.source enum is trusted

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §2 UserConsents/GpsFixes, §5, §7, §8, §12

title: [Phase 2] Tags API + system tag seed + attach rules
body:
## Goal
Implement tag catalog and author-only attach/detach behavior.

## Scope
- `GET /api/tags` (system + caller recent custom; optional `q`)
- `POST /api/tags` idempotent on `NormalizedName`
- System tags seeded immutable names (`IsSystem=1`)
- Normalization: trim + case-fold
- Data-point tag attach on create/update is author-only

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Concurrent custom tag creates return same tag
- [ ] System tags cannot be renamed via API
- [ ] Non-author cannot attach tags

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §2 Tags, §2 Tag Rules, §5

title: [Phase 2] Data points CRUD with required visibility and ownership rules
body:
## Goal
Implement create/read/update/soft-delete for data points with the §5 contract and visibility matrix.

## Scope
- `POST /api/datapoints` — title, description≤4000, eventDate, **required visibility**, exactly one of mapLocation|gpsFixId, optional chainId XOR linkToDataPointId, associationRadiusMeters, tags
- JSON presence validation so omitted visibility does not bind to Public/0
- `GET /api/datapoints/{id}` visibility-filtered detail + Ready media + tags + chain summary
- `PUT/DELETE` author-only soft-delete
- Shared not-found for missing vs forbidden sequential IDs
- HTML sanitize description

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Omitted visibility → 400 Problem Details
- [ ] Private only to author on user routes; FollowersOnly needs Accepted follow
- [ ] Soft-deleted rows hidden by default filters

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §4 Authorization Model, §5, §7.1, §12

title: [Phase 2] Chain association, candidates, timeline, and empty-chain first-node safety
body:
## Goal
Implement location chains per §2 association rules and §5 chain endpoints.

## Scope
- `GET /api/datapoints/chain-candidates` + `/gps` with heterogeneous ordering `(minVisibleDistance, candidateKind, stableId)` and caller-bound cursors
- `GET /api/chains/{chainId}/timeline` EventDate DESC/DataPointId DESC cursor
- `POST /api/chains` empty/titled chain
- `POST /api/chains/{chainId}/datapoints` add with radius rules; creator-only first node on empty chain
- MVP `linkToDataPointId` owner-only standalone merge with conditional claim under concurrency
- Empty-chain first-node conditional claim so only one concurrent winner bypasses proximity
- Visibility-filtered labels/counts never reveal hidden members

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Integration tests for concurrent first-node and concurrent linkToDataPointId races
- [ ] chainId and linkToDataPointId together → 400
- [ ] Timeline/cursor caller binding enforced

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §2 Chain Association Rules, §5 chain endpoints, §7

title: [Phase 2] Nearby + nearby/gps search endpoints
body:
## Goal
Proximity search with SQL geography distance, visibility predicate, and opaque cursors.

## Scope
- `GET /api/datapoints/nearby` and `/nearby/gps`
- Validate lat/lng/radius/pageSize before Point/STDistance
- Visibility: Public OR owner OR (FollowersOnly AND Accepted follow); private only when owner
- Keep follow test in SQL via EXISTS (do not materialize followee ids for Contains)
- Order by distance then DataPointId; retain SQL DistanceMeters on DTO for cursor
- Caller-bound opaque cursors; reject cross-account replay

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Matches §3 proximity example semantics
- [ ] Pending follows never unlock FollowersOnly
- [ ] Integration tests with spatial data

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §3 Proximity Query Example, §5, §7.2, §8

title: [Phase 2] Map viewport /in-bounds + place geocode search (Azure Maps)
body:
## Goal
Support map explore: viewport refine and address/place search.

## Scope
- `GET /api/datapoints/in-bounds` with north/south/east/west, zoom, mode=clusters|points, viewportToken, cursors, pageSize default 200 max 500
- Antimeridian split when west>east
- Cluster vs point cursor contracts bound to caller + viewportToken
- `GET /api/datapoints/search/place` via Azure Maps geocode → bounds + first page + continuation
- Bounding-box pre-filter before STDistance
- Provision/configure Azure Maps account (Terraform or documented external) and Key Vault secret if needed

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Viewport change invalidates prior cursor
- [ ] Place search returns mapBounds for client fit
- [ ] Low-zoom returns clusters/capped pages not unbounded points

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §5, §7.2, §10 Azure Maps

title: [Phase 2] Media upload init/complete with PendingReservedBytes quota
body:
## Goal
Author-only media reservation and completion for data-point attachments.

## Scope
- `POST /api/datapoints/{id}/media` with ClientRequestId + requestedSizeBytes + media type
- Reserve **per-type max** (photo 50MB / video 500MB) via conditional `PendingReservedBytes` update; refuse on 0-row
- User-delegation SAS create+write to staging path; TTL ≤ pending expiry (15m / 30m defaults)
- Idempotent retry returns same reservation without second debit
- `POST .../media/complete` validates size/signature, seals CanonicalETag, transitions status, outbox row once
- Counter release only for proxy uploads or expired/revoked write capability; direct-SAS rejects stay charged until expiry
- Canonical path layout per §6 Decisions

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Quota race tests pass
- [ ] Completion is idempotent; no duplicate outbox
- [ ] Read APIs never expose non-Ready media

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §5 media endpoints, §6, §8

title: [Phase 2] Media workers: outbox dispatcher, malware scan, thumbnails, cleanup janitors
body:
## Goal
Background processing pipeline so media becomes Ready only after clean scan + thumbnail + moderation gates on sealed CanonicalETag.

## Scope
- Outbox dispatcher (Function or in-process) with at-least-once publish and DedupKey
- Defender for Storage (or equivalent) + Event Grid → scan-result worker; bind verdict to CanonicalETag
- Thumbnail worker idempotent paths `media/{userId}/{dataPointId}/thumbnails/{uploadId}.jpg`
- Finalization transaction to Ready only when validation + clean malware + thumbnail + moderation approval all match sealed ETag
- Uncommitted-block inspector ≤60s while write SAS valid; committed oversize reaper; pending expiry janitor; quarantine hold expiry → Rejected+RejectedUtc; rejected retention purge 30d
- Size-enforcing proxy path for hard caps where required; direct SAS only as bounded cleanup for large video

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Malicious/timeout never parsed by ImageSharp/FFmpeg
- [ ] Stale scan events for other ETags ignored
- [ ] Janitors release PendingReservedBytes only after write capability ends on direct-SAS path

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §6 Architecture/Decisions, §8, §10 queues/Event Grid/Defender

title: [Phase 2] Admin moderation queue and media Ready gate endpoints
body:
## Goal
Admin-only moderation APIs and policies (`CanModerate`).

## Scope
- Authorization policies: CanViewFollowersOnly, CanViewPrivate (resource handlers), CanModerate (Admin role)
- `GET /api/moderation/queue`
- Hide datapoint/comment endpoints resolving linked open reports idempotently
- Media approve/reject (reject sets RejectedUtc; Ready only via separate finalization)
- Report dismiss
- Moderators do **not** bypass visibility on user-facing GET routes

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Non-admin receives 403 on moderation routes
- [ ] Approve alone does not publish without other gates
- [ ] Hide/dismiss idempotent

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §4, §5 moderation endpoints, §9

title: [Phase 2] Data export requests (receipt-gated download)
body:
## Goal
GDPR/CCPA portable export with one-time download receipt.

## Scope
- `POST /api/users/me/export-requests` returns one-time ≥256-bit receipt once; store only DownloadReceiptHash
- Async job builds archive of profile, consents, datapoints, Ready media metadata, comments, reactions, follows
- `GET /api/users/me/export-requests/{id}` owner job state; signed URL only with receipt header match and unexpired DownloadExpiresUtc (72h)
- Never authorize by path id or ownership alone; never put receipt in URLs/logs
- Janitor deletes blob after window; may keep scrubbed audit row
- Erasure must fence/cancel export jobs (coordinate with erasure issue)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Receipt required for download URL
- [ ] Rate limits per §8 where applicable
- [ ] Integration test covers happy path + missing receipt

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §5, §8, §12 Data export

title: [Phase 2] Erasure requests, worker, receipt-only status, ErasedSubjectHashes
body:
## Goal
Async right-to-erasure with anti-reprovisioning and receipt-only status after scrub.

## Scope
- `POST /api/users/me/erasure-requests` authenticated; one-time status receipt; store StatusReceiptHash only
- Worker ordered cleanup per §12 (fence media/export, delete blobs, FK-safe SQL, tombstone comments, insert ErasedSubjectHashes **before** Users scrub)
- `GET /api/erasure-requests/{id}` AllowAnonymous + receipt header; constant-time hash compare; ignore JWT for authZ; no JIT
- Legacy alias supported with same rules
- Rate limit 30/min per IP + id
- SubjectPseudonymKey versions remain available while referenced

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] After completion, same IdP subject gets 403 account-closed on JIT
- [ ] Status works without Users row using receipt only
- [ ] Export archives cannot block Users deletion

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §3 Caller Identity, §5 erasure routes, §12 erasure workflow, §8

title: [Phase 2] Retention janitors (GpsFixes, media rejected, data-point 10y)
body:
## Goal
Scheduled cleanup workers for operational and privacy retention defaults.

## Scope
- GpsFixes expiry purge (1 minute cadence)
- Media/Avatar rejected retention 30 days from RejectedUtc then hard-delete
- Quarantine manual-hold max 7 days → Rejected (not direct delete)
- Data-point retention 10 years from CreatedUtc (+30 day grace); purge or irreversible anonymize; soft-delete not terminal
- Document schedules alongside media janitors

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Workers are idempotent and safe to re-run
- [ ] Anchors use CreatedUtc not EventDate/UpdatedUtc for datapoint retention

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §8, §12 Data retention / GPS retention

title: [Phase 2] React SPA create UX (map pin, GPS, tags, visibility, chains)
body:
## Goal
Product create flow on the map per §7.1.

- Drop pin or use device GPS (GPS path uses consent + gpsFixId APIs)

- Association radius control + chain candidate panel + link/create chain

title: [Phase 2] React SPA search/explore UX (nearby, place, in-bounds, timeline)
body:
## Goal
Map+list explore experience per §7.2.

## Scope
- Nearby search controls; place/address search
- Viewport refine on moveend/zoomend debounced → `/in-bounds`
- Marker + list sync; cluster mode at low zoom
- Detail drawer + chain timeline scrubber

- [ ] Map bounds fit place results via mapBounds

title: [Phase 3] Follow request/accept/reject/unfollow + Accepted-only visibility
body:
## Goal
Social graph MVP with pending requests and Accepted-only unlock of FollowersOnly content.

## Scope
- `PUT/DELETE /api/users/{id}/follow`
- `GET /api/users/me/follow-requests` cursor pagination

title: [Phase 3] Comments and reactions (visibility-gated)
body:
## Goal
Enable discussion and reactions on visible data points.

## Scope
- `POST/GET /api/datapoints/{id}/comments` oldest-first cursor (createdUtc, commentId)
- Optional single-level parent threading with same-DataPointId enforcement
- Soft-delete filter on comments

- [ ] Cursor bounds enforced
- [ ] Author erasure tombstones comments on retained posts (coord with erasure)

- `docs/architecture-design.md` §2 Comments/Reactions, §5, §9

title: [Phase 3] Activity feed of Accepted followees
body:
## Goal
Chronological feed of posts from users the caller follows (Accepted only).

## Scope
- `GET /api/feed` newest-first; cursor binds caller + (createdUtc, dataPointId) seek `<`

title: [Phase 4] React Native parity for create/search/timeline
body:
## Goal
Ship mobile feature parity for core map create/search/timeline flows.

## Scope
- RN app auth (MSAL/Expo AuthSession PKCE)
- Map create with pin/GPS, visibility, tags, chains
- Nearby/place search and timeline
- Jest + Detox/Maestro smoke tests
- CI TypeScript + Jest validation

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Feature parity checklist vs Web for Phase 2 core flows
- [ ] Tokens use mobile app registration audience/scopes

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §1 Mobile, §4, §7, §11, §13 Phase 4

title: [Phase 4] Push notifications (Notification Hubs) — post-MVP polish
body:
## Goal
Add push notifications after core mobile parity (post-MVP social/mobile polish).

## Scope
- Azure Notification Hubs (or chosen provider) Terraform/manual setup
- Device registration API
- Notification triggers for follow accept, comments, moderation outcomes (define minimal set)
- Respect privacy/consent where applicable

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] End-to-end test on at least one platform (iOS or Android)
- [ ] Failure paths don’t break core API transactions

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §9 Post-MVP, §13 Phase 4

title: [Phase 4] Moderation automation and polish
body:
## Goal
Reduce operator toil and tighten moderation flows after the core social features ship.

## Scope
- Automate repeatable moderation queue triage/escalation where policy is deterministic
- Polish moderator workflows, auditing, and runbooks around hide/dismiss/reject actions
- Ensure automation remains idempotent and does not bypass admin-only controls

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Moderator workflow documents the automated vs. manual decision points
- [ ] Automation failures degrade to explicit operator action instead of silent drops

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §9 Moderation, §13 Phase 4

title: [Phase 4] Performance hardening (caching, CDN, spatial tuning)
body:
## Goal
Improve post-MVP performance for map/search/media paths without weakening the documented security model.

## Scope
- Tune nearby/in-bounds spatial query plans and supporting indexes from production findings
- Add safe caching where responses are explicitly cacheable and visibility rules still hold
- Finish CDN/front-door polish for eligible media and API delivery paths without caching protected SAS routes

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Benchmark or load-test evidence captures the before/after impact for targeted hotspots
- [ ] Any new caching rules preserve the documented authorization and no-store requirements for protected media

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §6 CDN notes, §8 operational bounds, §13 Phase 4

title: [Infra] Media storage, queues, Event Grid, Defender, RBAC
body:
## Goal
Provision media pipeline Azure resources and least-privilege RBAC.

## Scope
- Media storage account; disable anonymous access
- Queue/Service Bus for media work
- Event Grid system topic + subscriptions for blob create + malware results
- Defender for Storage enablement (Terraform or runbook if manual)
- Role assignments: API Storage Blob Delegator + least-privilege data; workers read/write as needed
- Blob CORS mirror SPA origins for upload methods only

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Terraform plan includes resources/RBAC
- [ ] Runbook covers Defender if outside TF

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §6, §10 New Resources, §12 Network Security

title: [Infra] Front Door Premium + WAF for API and media; origin lock-down
body:
## Goal
Put API and media behind Azure Front Door with WAF and locked App Service origin.

## Scope
- FD profile/endpoint/origin groups/routes (Premium)
- WAF policy + security policy association (OWASP)
- Origin probe to anonymous `GET /healthz/live`
- SAS media routes no-store / no cache (or cache key varies on full SAS query if ever enabled)
- App Service access restriction: require `AzureFrontDoor.Backend` **and** matching `X-Azure-FDID`, then deny

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Direct origin access blocked without FD identity
- [ ] Header-only checks not relied upon alone
- [ ] Health probe succeeds

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §10, §12 Network Security

title: [Infra] VNet, private SQL endpoint/DNS, Key Vault, App Insights, Log Analytics
body:
## Goal
Private network boundary and observability for production posture.

## Scope
- VNet + subnets
- SQL private endpoint + private DNS zone + **VNet link** + **DNS zone group**
- Disable SQL public network access when PE live
- App Service VNet integration (swift connection)
- Key Vault for SubjectPseudonymKey versions, Maps key if needed; RBAC
- Application Insights + Log Analytics
- Narrow firewall guidance; do not enable “Allow Azure services” casually

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] API reaches SQL privately in target env
- [ ] Name resolution works via zone group/link
- [ ] Diagnostics flow to Log Analytics

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §10, §12 Network/App security

title: [DevOps] EF migration bundle deploy job + SPA/mobile CI + Playwright cutover
body:
## Goal
Align CI/CD with redesign hosting and test strategy.

## Scope
- Build EF migration bundle in CI; apply from VNet-connected/self-hosted or Azure-side job that can reach private SQL
- Remove remaining Database sql-action path
- Node SPA build/test; RN validation
- Retarget Playwright to React SPA create/search/timeline/media flows
- Fail on dotnet format / ESLint / tsc for touched projects
- Optional load test harness hooks (k6/Azure Load Testing) for nearby/in-bounds

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Migration apply documented and automated for target env
- [ ] Playwright green against SPA for core flows
- [ ] Old Razor E2E retired after cutover

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §11, §13

title: [Cutover] Remove Razor Frontend and Functions public HTTP API after SPA/API launch
body:
## Goal
Complete host cutover: public traffic only on `ReMind.Api` + `ReMind.Web`; Functions remain workers-only if needed.

## Scope
- Feature-flag/traffic shift plan from Razor+function-key to JWT API + SPA
- Remove `ReMind.Frontend` and Functions **HTTP triggers** from deploy/CI after parity sign-off
- Keep thumbnail/outbox/janitor Functions as workers only (not second public API)
- Update README and infra app settings

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No function-key public API remains
- [ ] Workers still deploy if required by media pipeline
- [ ] Rollback notes captured

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §1 decisions, Current vs Target, §13

title: [Security] App-layer hardening checklist (CORS, headers, rate limits, receipts, sanitization)
body:
## Goal
Track cross-cutting application security controls called out in §12 that span many features.

## Scope
- CORS allow-list only
- Security headers on SPA/API responses
- Rate limits: auth, place search, media/avatar init, erasure/export status
- Receipt/cursor entropy + constant-time compare + short TTL
- Input sanitization and upload signature validation
- Soft-delete filters; shared not-found behavior
- Secrets only via Key Vault + managed identity; SubjectPseudonymKey rotation rules (referenced versions stay retrievable)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checklist verified in staging
- [ ] Security tests or documented manual probes attached

## References
- `docs/architecture-design.md` §12 Application Security, §8
